citation.title: The Impact of Stray Magnetic Fields on the KSTAR NBI Performance
citation.authors: Hong, SeulChan; Baek, Geonwoo; Jang, Jae Young; Na, Byungkeun; Jeong, J.H.; Lee, C.Y.; Park, Min; Kim, Jaewook; Kwak, Jong-Gu; Na, Yong-Su

topic: Stray PF-coil fields and beamline pressure reducing KSTAR NBI-1 delivered power; offline Monte Carlo beam tracing, with BES used as a qualitative cross-check.
own_question: How much do stray fields degrade NBI-1 power and injection angle, and does this affect long-pulse plasma performance?
actual_method_and_evidence: Monte Carlo particle tracing (Lorentz force, leap-frog, uniform assumed pressure, charge-exchange cross-sections). The source reports an 11.5% simulated power drop versus a 19.7% BES signal drop in discharge #27327, and states that the angle distortion is negligible for CES. All of this is offline; there is no CES temperature nowcasting.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In KSTAR, the source attributes a slow NBI power decline during some long or high-Ip discharges to stray fields combined with beam-chamber pressure. Beam-based signals such as BES or CES could therefore have time-varying beam contributions.
claim_checks.qualification: This is a modeled estimate from an unpeer-reviewed preprint. The simulation underestimates the BES drop, and the source authors attribute the gap to the uniform-pressure assumption. The source makes no statement about CES temperature accuracy.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: The source authors estimate the beam injection-angle distortion at under about 0.06 degrees and judge it not to affect CES measurement position.
claim_checks.qualification: This is an author interpretation from simulation, not a measured CES validation.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not applicable. The source has no CES report timing and no 10 ms nowcast.
validation_if_relevant: There is no holdout or validation design. The only comparison is to a single BES trace, and predictive TRIASSIC runs are reported for #32732.
forbidden_inferences: Do not cite this source as evidence on CES Ti nowcasting or BES/ECEI predictive information.
Do not claim the source shows that CES labels are biased.
Do not treat simulated power loss as measured.
Do not generalize to KSTAR2022 pedestal-top chord data.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional context only: if we discuss time-varying NBI conditions affecting beam-based diagnostics in long pulses. Otherwise exclude.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
